Jylli Tool 2.0: before and after

Same app, same features. Screenshots from the preview harness (mock data, 1280×820). Before is the 1.6.0 interface; after shows the redesigned interface in dark and the new light theme.

Home

Spec chips gone from the title bar, one health hero, cleaner hierarchy.

Optimize › Fixes

Card grid of identical glowing buttons became a dense, quiet list.

Optimize › Windows

Same tweaks, tokenised colours, no glow, no side rails, sentence-case labels.

Gaming › Pulse

Idle rules stay readable, no coloured rails, game picker and Activate come first.

Clean › Startup

Consistent chips, tokens and contrast.

System › Processes

Rebuilt on the component layer with keyboard-reachable sortable headers.

Settings

Theme switch (System / Dark / Light) under Appearance.
